**Panel**:
A bordered container that groups related fields on one screen.
_Avoid_: box, widget, section card (never "card" alone)

**Workspace**:
The top-level space a team shares.
_Avoid_: org, tenant

**Seat**:
One licensed person in a workspace.
_Avoid_: user slot
